mode: Research measurements from DIFFERENT experimental environments. The numbers are NOT a matched sour-service comparison and must NEVER be described as 60 C / 3 bar H2S predictions for every material.

6061_T6.label: Al 6061-T6
6061_T6.rateMethod: CALCULATED, not reported: 0.00327 × i_corr(µA/cm²) × (26.9815385/3 g/equiv) / 2.70 g/cm³ (Al3+ simplified)
6061_T6.environment: 3.5 wt% NaCl aqueous solution; no added H₂S. Uncoated reference specimen from Table 3 (*) in cited publication; electrochemical CPPC.
6061_T6.temperature: Not established as the 60°C sour scenario
6061_T6.sourceTitle: Effect of Citric Acid Hard Anodizing on the Mechanical Properties and Corrosion Resistance of Different Aluminum Alloys (2024)
6061_T6.limit: Equivalent penetration assumes uniform dissolution and approximate Al3+ stoichiometry; electrochemical conversion ignores localized pitting and alloy element valence. No H2S exposure; not validated for wet sour service.

7075_T6.label: Al 7075-T6
7075_T6.rateMethod: CALCULATED, not reported: 0.00327 × i_corr(µA/cm²) × (26.9815385/3 g/equiv) / 2.81 g/cm³ (Al3+ simplified)
7075_T6.environment: Same 3.5 wt% NaCl aqueous solution without added H₂S, same paper/Table 3, uncoated reference specimen (*)
7075_T6.temperature: Not established as the 60°C sour scenario
7075_T6.sourceTitle: Effect of Citric Acid Hard Anodizing on the Mechanical Properties and Corrosion Resistance of Different Aluminum Alloys (2024)
7075_T6.limit: Equivalent penetration assumes uniform dissolution and Al3+ chemistry despite a multicomponent alloy; no matched H2S test. Low current under this chloride experiment does not establish superior sour-service resistance.

1020_NORMALIZED.label: AISI 1020 normalized candidate
1020_NORMALIZED.paperUnit: weight-loss corrosion rate over surface finishes
1020_NORMALIZED.rateMethod: DIRECT published weight-loss result; lower 0.58 mm/y smoother-finish specimen is visualized. 0.92 mm/y is higher-roughness reference, NOT pitting rate.
1020_NORMALIZED.environment: 25°C, CO₂-saturated 3 wt% NaCl, pH ~5, static glass cell, weight-loss immersion 168 h (7 days)
1020_NORMALIZED.sourceTitle: Mechanistic Role of Surface Roughness on CO₂ Corrosion Kinetics and Pitting Susceptibility of AISI 1020 Carbon Steel (2026)
1020_NORMALIZED.limit: Not tested in sour H2S. Normalized heat treatment not established. Surface roughness alters results. 0.58 is the lower measured finish, not a sour-service minimum.

AISI_304.label: AISI 304
AISI_304.rateMethod: DIRECT paper-reported uncoated 304 stainless steel substrate benchmark
AISI_304.environment: H₂S-containing simulated oil-and-gas-field medium; the accessible abstract does not state the complete pressure, temperature, electrolyte or immersion duration. Paper compares HVOF-coated with uncoated substrate.
AISI_304.sourceTitle: Assessment of Sulfide Corrosion and Wear Behavior of HVOF-Sprayed Cr3C2–25NiCr Coating on 304 Stainless Steels in H2S Environment (2023)
AISI_304.limit: Abstract provides 0.17 mm/year substrate benchmark but not complete test conditions; cannot assume 60°C/3 bar H2S; coating result not used.

AISI_316.label: AISI 316 candidate, 316L proxy
AISI_316.rateMethod: DIRECT measured 316L coupon weight-loss rate; used only as explicitly labeled proxy for AISI 316 grade
AISI_316.environment: 60°C, H₂S partial pressure 3 bar, total 30 bar (H₂S 3 bar + N₂ 27 bar), 5 wt% NaCl + 0.5 wt% acetic acid, pH ~3, ~7 days
AISI_316.sourceTitle: The Effect of H₂S Pressure on the Formation of Multiple Corrosion Products on 316L Stainless Steel Surface (Shah et al., 2020)
AISI_316.limit: 316L is a different grade than AISI 316 and may not be treated as guaranteed equal. The reported 0.74 mm/y uniform corrosion cannot establish pitting damage or cracking suitability.

conversionReference.equivalentWeightAssumption: Aluminum dominant dissolution Al→Al3+ +3e, 26.9815385/3 g/equiv; approximate for aluminum alloys

note: Mode 1 distributes the selected study's UNIFORM corrosion benchmark over 100% of triangulated CAD faces. Because papers did not measure this drum's spatial corrosion field, no pitting hotspot is created in Mode 1. Calculated penetration after t days and two-sided wall thinning are hypothetical transfers from coupon measurements to the model geometry. Not valid for ranking all five under the same field conditions.
